3.4 COM-Stack configuration
To cope with the complexity of the COM-Stack configuration, reoccurring patterns have
been applied which will be described in this section. Only the patterns, together with
some examples, are shown. To get detailed specification of the configuration for each
individual module please refer to the actual BSW SWS documents of these modules.
